title: CCXT Extract Signing Recipe Record
description: Declarative per-section signing recipe. One record per authenticated API section, keyed in `structure.sign_recipe` by section name (e.g. "private", "sapi", "fapiPrivate"). Consumers use this record to construct an authenticated HTTP request without walking the raw sign() AST. All derivation fields are nullable: null means the value has not yet been derived (see `unresolved_reason`) — per the Honesty Rule, extraction never silently guesses. Task 64 ships the schema with every field null; Tasks 65–69 populate the fields incrementally. An exchange-schema copy lives at `exchange_v2.json#/$defs/SignRecipeRecord`; the two must stay in lockstep (enforced by `test/ccxt_extract/sign_recipe_test.exs`).

crypto_op.description: Hash / signature algorithm plus optional rationale. Populated by Task 65.

oneOf.description: Per-verb map. Keys are HTTP verb names (GET|POST|PUT|DELETE|PATCH) when the sign() method branches on `method === 'X'`, or the sentinel `*` when every verb in the section shares the same canonical string. Populated by Tasks 66a (HMAC-simple entries) and 66b (HMAC-with-body entries) in parallel — a single section may carry both families under different verb keys (e.g. OKX.private.GET = hmac_simple, OKX.private.POST = hmac_with_body). JWT / RSA / Ed25519 (66c) and custom (66d) are currently deferred.

signature_placement.description: Where the final signature is attached to the request. Populated by Task 65.

auth_headers.description: Ordered list of auth-related headers required on the request. Excludes the signature header itself (use `signature_placement` for that). Populated by Task 67.

nonce.description: Timestamp / nonce source and wire format. Populated by Task 67.

pre_sign_transforms.description: Ordered list of transforms applied to the canonical string, body, or resulting signature before it goes on the wire. Populated by Task 68.

unresolved_reason.description: Closed-vocabulary reason when one or more derivation fields are null. `"not_yet_derived"` is the scaffold default before any Phase 10 derivation has run. Must be null only when every derivation field above is non-null; Task 69 enforces this invariant.

patch_count.description: Three-Strikes counter (see CLAUDE.md). Each time a derivation rule is patched to handle a new edge case, the patch_count for affected recipes bumps by one. At 3, the knowledge migrates to `priv/overrides/<id>.json` rather than accreting more special cases in derivation.

key.description: Header name, query-param name, or body-field name carrying the final signature (e.g. "X-BAPI-SIGN", "signature").
